basic_info_description:
Adorable and charming! Thoughtfully and freshly FULLY remodeled corner home with beautiful hardwood floors and plenty of natural light from the south and west. Views to the ocean from dining and living rooms. Within walking distance to public transportation (L-muni), dining, grocery stores. So close to Stern Grove, SF Zoo and the beach! Close to SFSU, SI, St. Gabriel School, six blocks to Ocean Beach. 
Be the first to experience remodelled Outer Sunset living here!

KITCHEN: Brand new tile, lots of new cabinet storage, new quartz counters, new lighting, skylight, brand new stainless appliances! Eat in kitchen area. Be the first to use everything!

DINING ROOM: Large dining room with ocean views and natural light. Brand new paint, lighting, windows and refinished floors. Small closet. 

LIVING ROOM: Large living room with views to ocean and lovely natural light. Brand new paint, lighting, windows and refinished floors. Faux fireplace mantel in living room.

BEDROOMS - TWO with closets, (one new) new windows, paint, lighting and refinished floors. 

BATHROOM: Brand new bathroom with subway tile, natural light streaming in from a new skylight, new tub/fixtures and lighting. Large linen/storage closet. 

GARAGE: Brand new garage door. Parking space for 2 cars (tandem garage), garage is connected indoors to house. LOTS of garage storage for bikes/equipment. -Laundry (washer, dryer located in garage)

-New fenced in backyard.

-Small under 30 lb dog friendly. Pet deposit is applicable.
-Landlord does not live on site.
-Renter pays for all utilities.
-Absolutely NO smoking indoors.

-1 year lease.
$4500 per month.
$4500 security deposit.
$500 pet deposit (if applicable).
